SPECIFICATION FOR 

OSCILLATING SHAFT CRANK FOR 

SEWING MACHINES FOR HOUSEHOLD PURPOSES 



1. Scope— Lays down the requirements for oscillating shaft crank for sewing machines for household 
purposes. 

1.1 It does not cover the oscillating shaft crank for sewing machines for industrial and special 
purposes. 

2. Nomenclature — Shall be as shown in Fig. 1. 



SIDE FACE 




FACE F 




FIG. 1 NOMENCLATURE FOR OSCILLATING SHAFT CRANK 

3. Material — The oscillating shaft crank shall be made from cast iron conforming to grade FG 150 of 
IS : 210-1978 'Grey iron casting ( third revision )'. 

4. Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Fig. 2.

5. Tolerances 

5.1 The error in parallelism of the axis of the main holes of the oscillating shaft crank shall be 
within 015 per 100 mm. 

5.2 The error in parallelism between the axis X\ and X2 of the oscillating shaft crank shall be 
within 002 mm. 

5.3 The error in perpendicularity of the face 'F' to the axis/2 shall be within 0010 mm. 

6. Workmanship and Finish 

6.1 The main holes of oscillating shaft 'crank shall be reamed. 

6.2 The side faces of the oscillating shaft crank shall be machined without any tool marks. 

6.3 The casting shall be free from defects, such as blow holes, flaws, cracks or burrs and shall be 
chemically coloured or suitably plated. 

7. Marking —The oscillating shaft crank shall be marked with the manufacturer's name or trade-mark, 
if required. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — Each oscillating shaft crank shall be given a suitable antirust coating or wrapped in 
vapour phase inhibitor paper ( commonly known as VPI paper ). The wrapped oscillating shaft crank 
shall be securely packed in accordance with the best prevalent trade practice. Each packing shall bear 
the manufacturer's name or trade-mark, the type and description of contents. 

9. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the supplier and the purchaser, the sampling 
plan as given in Apppendix A shall be followed. For further infoiimeticn, refererce may te mede to 
IS : 2500( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count of 
defects ( first revision )'. 



APPENDIX A 
( Clause 9 ) 

SCALE OF SAMPLING AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 

A-1. Scale of Sampling 

A-1.1 Lot — In any consignment all the oscillating shaft crank of same type and manufactured from 
the same material under essentially similar conditions of manufacture shall be grouped together to 
constitute a lot. 

A-1 -2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lot to the requirements of specification, test shall be 
carried out for each lot separately. The number of oscillating shaft crank to be selected at random for 
this purpose shall be in accordance with col 1 and 2 of Table 1. 

A-1. 3 If the oscillating shaft cranks are packed individually, in order to ensure the randomness of 
selection, IS : 4905-1968 'Methods for random sampling' shall be used. 

A-1.4 If the oscillating shaft cranks are packed in different cartons, a suitable number of cartons ( not 
less than 20 percent of the total in the lot subject to minimum of 2 ) shall be chosen at random. From 
each of the cartons so chosen, an approximately equal number of oscillating shaft crank shall be 
picked up from its different parts so as to obtain the required number of oscillating shaft crank 
specified in col 2 of Table 1. 

A-2. Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity 

A-2.1 The oscillating shaft crank selected according to A-1.2 and A-1.3 or A-1.4 shall be examined for 
dimensions ( see 4 ), tolerances ( see 5 ) and workmanship and finish ( see 6 ). If number of oscillating 
shaft crank failing to meet one or more of the requirements mentioned above is less than or equal to 
the permissible number of defectives given in col 3 of Table 1, the lot shall be declared as conforming 
to the requirements of those characteristics.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been prepared to unify and rationalize the type and sizes of sewing machines 
components for manufacturing in economic quantities.
